title: Arena draft and pending-operation recovery store

claims.text: Drafts keys every record as lineage-arena-v1:tool:scope with version 1, defaulting to an empty draft when storage holds nothing.

get rejects records over 65536 bytes, validates the draft and any pending operation against the live tool descriptors, requiring matching actor, op_id, expected_head, bench scope, and a fake runner for bench_run.
save persists the record to localStorage and complete removes the storage key and deletes the pending entry, both reporting storage-unavailable notices on failure.

decision.rule: Change here when draft persistence, pending-operation recovery, or storage keying needs to change.
decision.failure: An invalid saved draft is recovered as current, a mismatched pending operation is retried, or a completed operation leaves its pending entry behind.

questions.q: Where does Drafts validate a pending operation against the tool descriptors?
Where should I change the storage key or record version for saved drafts?
Where can I debug why a saved draft is marked unsafe or unavailable?
